samples.analysis:
Google Chrome is open in Incognito mode on a YOLOKFX webpage titled **“How to Get Free SHEIN Products.”**

- A black site header shows the **YOLOKFX** logo, navigation links **Home, Fashion, Trends, Contact**, and a search icon.
- The main article column begins with the title and the subtitle: “Discover how the official SHEIN reviewer program works and learn how to apply for product testing opportunities.”
- A centered questionnaire asks **“One last question and we will show you how!”** and **“How would you prefer to receive your free items?”** with two green buttons: **Store pickup** and **Home delivery**.
- To the right is a Capital One Shopping ad stating **“Coupon codes found!”** with a blue **Apply Codes** button.
- Below, a large **SHEIN** heading and **“OFFICIAL REVIEWER PROGRAM”** badge introduce text explaining that selected users may test products for feedback, but selection is **never guaranteed**.
- A prominent section reads **“🔥 THE MOST IMPORTANT STEP BEFORE APPLYING”**, advising users to keep their SHEIN profile accurate and apply only through the **official SHEIN website or mobile app**, not third parties.
- The next heading, **“How the Official SHEIN Reviewer…”**, is partially visible at the bottom.
